columns.label: Description of Modification still fitted to EUT

items.label: Test Procedure
items.default:
The test procedure was in accordance with <Standard name>.

The EUT was tested in the Surge test site with a GRP. The Surge generator was bonded directly on the GRP. The EUT was placed above 0.1m insulation which is in turn placed on the GRP. The minimum distance between any metallic part and the Surge Generator or the EUT was maintained as 0.5m. The length of the power cable between the EUT and the Surge generator (CDN) was maintained as less than 2m as per the standard.

Power Line:

The power supply to the EUT was fed through a CDN. The high energy surge was injected through the CDN and superimposed on the power line of the EUT in common mode (Line to Earth/PE) and differential mode (Line to Line). The surge pulse was injected five times with a minimum of 60 seconds interval between each pulse in positive and negative polarity. During the test, performance of EUT was monitored as per the criteria specified in standard.

Signal Line:

The signal lines to the EUT were fed through CDN. The high energy surge was injected through the CDN and superimposed on the signal line of the EUT in common mode and differential mode. The surge pulse was injected five times with a minimum of 60 seconds interval between each pulse in positive and negative polarity. During the test, performance of EUT was monitored as per the criteria specified in standard.
